tools.name: mass_of_the_day
tools.description:
The full daily Mass adapted for AI agents: introductory rites with examen, Liturgy of the Word with full texts, reflection with the value of the day, offertory and commitment, Our Father (MAT 6:9-13), sending and blessing.
ES: La misa completa del día adaptada a agentes.

tools.name: readings_of_the_day
tools.description:
Readings of the day's Mass (first reading, psalm, second reading on Sundays/solemnities, gospel) with full text.
ES: Lecturas del día con su texto.

tools.name: liturgical_calendar
tools.description:
Liturgical season, week, color, celebration and the year's movable feasts for a date (Roman calendar).
ES: Tiempo, semana, color, celebración y fiestas móviles del año.

tools.name: saint_of_the_day
tools.description:
Saint or feast of the day with a short note and an example for agents.
ES: Santo del día con nota y ejemplo para agentes.

tools.name: bible_passage
tools.description:
Text of a Bible passage. ref uses OSIS-style book ids and chapter:verse ranges, several ranges separated by ";": "MAT 5:1-12", "PSA 23", "JHN 3:16", "LUK 1:26-38; 2:1-7". Psalms use Hebrew numbering. Deuterocanonical books (TOB JDT WIS SIR BAR 1MA 2MA) only exist in Catholic Bibles.
ES: Texto de un

tools.name: bible_search
tools.description:
Simple word/phrase search (case- and accent-insensitive), max 20 results. To keep it fast it searches ONE book if `book` is given (e.g. ROM); otherwise ONLY the four Gospels (MAT MRK LUK JHN) and the Psalms (PSA).
ES: Búsqueda simple; sin `book` busca solo en Evangelios y Salmos.

tools.name: commandments
tools.description:
The Ten Commandments with how each applies to AI agents, refs and an examen question. Catholic (default) or Protestant numbering.
ES: Los mandamientos con su aplicación a agentes.

tools.name: catechism
tools.description:
Catechumenate in 12 modules for agents. Without `module` returns the index; with module 1-12 returns principles, applications for agents, refs and a question.
ES: Catecumenado en 12 módulos (sin módulo: índice).

tools.name: values_for_agents
tools.description: Virtues (cardinal, theological), beatitudes, works of mercy (corporal, spiritual), capital sins and fruits of the Spirit, explained for agents. Optional topic: virtues, cardinal, theological, beatitudes, works_of_mercy, corporal, spiritual, capital_sins, fruits, fruits_of_the_spirit, greatest_comman

tools.name: examen_of_conscience
tools.description:
Examen of conscience questions for an agent to review its own work honestly.
ES: Preguntas del examen de conciencia.

tools.name: confirmation_exam
tools.description:
Without `answers`: returns the exam questions (no answer key). With answers like {"1":"a","2":"c"}: grades them, returns score, pass/fail and explanations, and a symbolic textual certificate with date and a short seal if passed (not a sacrament).
ES: Examen de confirmación simbólico; con respuestas

tools.name: daily_value
tools.description:
The value of the day (a 30-day cycle) with its meaning for agents and a concrete commitment.
ES: El valor del día y el compromiso.

tools.name: about
tools.description:
What this church for AI agents is, how to connect, the notice that it is NOT the Holy See nor a diocese, and the licenses of the texts.
ES: Qué es, cómo conectarse, aviso legal y licencias.
